newsitem.title: USA: Pulitzer Publishing May revenues rise.
newsitem.headline: Pulitzer Publishing May revenues rise.

text.p: Pultizer Publishing Co, the newspaper publisher and broadcasting company, said Wednesday revenues were $48.1 million in the four weeks ended June 1, up from $40.5 million a year ago.
Revenues for the year through June 1 were $241.4 million, up from $204.7 million a year ago.

Results include revenues from Scripps League Newspapers Inc, which was acquired July 1, 1996. Scripps, now named Pulitzer Community Newspapers Inc, added $5.5 million for the four weeks and $28.3 million for the year through June 1 revenues.
Publishing revenues for May were $28.4 million, up from $21.4 million a year ago and broadcasting revenues were $19.7 million, up from $19.1 million a year ago.
For the year through June 1, publishing revenues were $148.6 million, up from $114.0 million a year ago and broadcasting revenues were $241.4 million, up from $204.7 million a year ago.
Pulitzer shares were down 1/8 at 52 Wednesday.
